Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE square canonical movement identity photograph for a premium strength-training app, with one adult male athlete actually performing the specified exercise. Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL APPROVED MASTER STYLE SPECIMEN; every output must match it directly in natural muscular physique, adult age, graphite sleeveless shirt, black shorts, dark shoes, realistic skin and fabric, brushed silver metal, premium dark studio, charcoal textured floor, restrained violet rim light from rear right, neutral soft key from upper left/front. Preserve this visual grammar without copying its incline-press pose. Dark floor, no bright white soles, no bright colored lighting. Choose the specified camera for movement mechanics; comparable 60–70 mm photographic perspective. Square framing, full athlete and all required equipment in frame, about 8% dark crop-safe perimeter, occupy most of frame. Hands must anatomically grip the real handles; two arms, two hands, two legs; credible joints, contact, supports and equipment. Only required equipment. No text, logos, anatomy overlays, collages, diagrams, extra people or mirrors. Deliver one finished photograph.
CRITICAL: Original image1 supplies STYLE ONLY. Do not preserve its athlete pose, wrist orientation or incline bench. Re-stage the new exact movement, with its own correct bench angle, support and equipment.
EXACT GOVERNED MOVEMENT 47: Cambered-Bar Bench Press. Athlete supine on horizontal flat bench, feet grounded, pressing a real CAMBERED straight-grip bench bar: the central gripping shaft is dropped in a shallow rectangular U relative to the two higher horizontal sleeve axes, with equal vertical bends outside both hands before sleeves. No multi-grip handles. Identical modest plates and collars on two collinear higher sleeves. Low pressing phase central shaft at chest while elevated sleeves/plates stay higher, showing extra range camber. Front oblique camera shows entire symmetrical purpose-built bar and both grip points; nothing intersects athlete.
review_reason: Initial prompt specified the camber on the wrong side of the grip. Manufacturer's pressing reference confirms raised central chest-clearance section between hands, with hands on lower outer straight grips. Rebuild geometry; do not reuse this candidate.
